cases.review_note: I/you/she travelled are plausible without speaker context; do not reject an alternative solely against one guessed voice.
Conventional names; inspect without treating one individual name pronunciation as certain.
Egyptian colloquial; an MSA benchmark does not certify readable colloquial pronunciation.

Exact Latin accents/digits/punctuation must survive; Arabic speaker gender unspecified.
Supplied عَلِمَ marks must not be replaced with model preference.
Zero-width and exact original base-letter bytes remain in the original; model normalization is metadata-only.
Arabic inside the protected URL must remain exact, not vocalized or normalized.
Code identifier and filename must survive exact.
Unsupported Persian kaf/yeh variants require explicit mapping; never rewrite original script.
